data.name: Shrouded Frontier
data.detailed_description:
Play as a low level bounty hunter known as Wraith in a corrupt galaxy edge known as the Shrouded Frontier where law and order is only what the current power claims it is.

Customize the character with different gadgets and weapons that you find or purchase to hunt bounty contracts from multiple entities any way you desire. The weapons and gadgets will support every playstyle. If you’re a classic pistol gunslinger with only your fav pistol and flamethrower gadget, a stealth expert who prefers up close and personal with their sword and grapple gadget for the the ultimate ninja experience, or a guns blazing tank who believes the only right way is straight through with maximum casualties with the most guns equipped as possible, the experience with support it all. 

Bounties- Bring them in dead or alive for different payouts and rewards. 

Freedom of approach- this open world sandbox experience will offer unlimited possibilities and play styles to be the Wraith you want to be. From a grapple hook gadget, to zip lines, pipe climbing, vent infiltration, elevators, jetpack usage, and classic parkour. Your traversal options with be the ultimate freedom of expression. A key pillar to the experience. 

Reputation is everything- balance reputation from multiple factions to discover allies, be trusted with higher more dangerous contracts, and much more. How you play, the people you terminate, the decisions you make in the world with change your personal morality and your reputation among the factions in the world. 

Economy- with all that money you’ll earn, what can you do with it? Spend it on upgrading or purchasing your favorite weapons, gadgets, outfits, and even multiple places to call home. Down to every detail you’ll have the option to put alternate colors for your projectiles, visor, and gadgets for the ultimate player expression.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11 OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (10th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 3 3000 series+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • VR Support: no

content_descriptors.notes: This content will include killing and blood.
